items.summary: Recommendation: do not queue the allthingsmasonic.com prototype yet. Retain it conditionally behind a finance measurement gate. The 2026-09-21 Amazon snapshot shows 61 site clicks, 0 site-attributed orders, and $0 attributed commission; the $4.92 aggregate commission from 28 orders and 6 shipped items cannot be assigned to this site. The available scorecard shows 41 sessions and 3 conversions, but conversion value is undefined. Fleet AI spend was $943.09 for 5,249 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26; allthingsmasonic.com shows $9.84 in the authoritative AI ledger. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, ROI, and revenue forecast are not calculable because infrastructure cost, labor cost, incremental experiment cost, conversion value, and site-level commission are unavailable. Minimum gate: reconcile treated-page impressions, outbound clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, AI cost, and attributable infrastructure cost for one defined measurement window. Do not treat SEO impressions, sessions, conversions, or Amazon aggregate revenue as financial performance.
